_about.purpose: Ground truth for the ARCC 2026 Q2 panels, derived independently of the parser by agent B. Every figure below was obtained from the source filing and/or the XBRL companyfacts API, never from anything the parser wrote.

methods.M1_html: Rendered text of the CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEETS table in arcc-20260630.htm (byte offset ~2,754,342), read with lxml.html.text_content() over a 60 KB slice. Verbatim: 'CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEETS(in millions, except per share data) As of June 30, 2026  December 31, 2025 (unaudited) ...'.
methods.M2_inline_xbrl: ix:nonFraction facts embedded in arcc-20260630.htm, filtered to contexts with zero xbrldi:explicitMember dimensions and the stated instant, taking the FIRST occurrence in document order (the balance sheet is the first statement in the filing). scale and sign attributes applied. All balance-sheet facts carry scale=6.
methods.M3_companyfacts: https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0001287750.json, cached at manifest.facts_path, filtered to instant facts (no 'start' key) with end == the stated date.

_about.IMPORTANT_companyfacts_gap: The companyfacts JSON, both the cached copy and a live refetch on 2026-08-16, contains NO facts from accession 0001628280-26-050307. Its most recent accession is 0001628280-26-027688 (2026 Q1 10-Q) and its latest instant is 2026-03-31. Therefore companyfacts can independently confirm the 2025-12-31 comparative column ONLY. For 2026-06-30 the independent reference is the filing's own inline XBRL (M2), which is a different extraction path from reading the rendered table and so is still independent of the parser.

source_scale.comment: M1: the balance-sheet caption reads '(in millions, except per share data)'. M2: every balance-sheet and Schedule of Investments ix:nonFraction fact carries scale="6". All money values below are already converted to actual USD dollars, which is what plan section 1 requires of the panel.

balance_sheet_columns.comment: M1: header reads 'As of June 30, 2026 / December 31, 2025', and the section heading at offset 2,730,691 reads 'Consolidated Balance Sheets as of June 30, 2026 (unaudited) and December 31, 2025 (audited)'. M2 independently confirms it: us-gaap:Assets appears exactly twice in an undimensioned context, at instants 2026-06-30 and 2025-12-31. The comparative date was READ, not inferred: 2026-06-30 minus one quarter would give 2026-03-31, which is wrong.

current._comment: This date equals periodOfReport exactly (plan check 6).

total_investments_fv.comment: M1 line 'Total investments at fair value (amortized cost of $29,675 and $29,250, respectively) 29,349 29,485' -> 29,349 million. M2: first undimensioned us-gaap:InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue @ 2026-06-30 = 29349000000. M3: unavailable (see IMPORTANT_companyfacts_gap).

total_investments_cost.comment: M1 parenthetical 'amortized cost of $29,675'. M2: first undimensioned us-gaap:InvestmentOwnedAtCost @ 2026-06-30 = 29675000000. This is the figure plan check 14 ties sum(investment.cost) to; the condition for check 14 IS met for this filing.

total_assets.comment: M1 'Total assets $30,498'. M2 us-gaap:Assets @ 2026-06-30 = 30498000000. Cross-confirmed by us-gaap:LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity @ 2026-06-30 = 30498000000. M3 unavailable.

total_liabilities.comment: M1 'Total liabilities 16,607'. M2 us-gaap:Liabilities @ 2026-06-30. M3 unavailable.

net_assets.comment: M1 'Total stockholders' equity 13,891'. M2 us-gaap:StockholdersEquity @ 2026-06-30 (first undimensioned occurrence; later occurrences at this instant are equity-rollforward components 1 / 13,359 / 531 which sum to 13,891). M3 unavailable.

nav_per_share.comment: M1 'NET ASSET VALUE PER SHARE $19.35'. M2 us-gaap:NetAssetValuePerShare @ 2026-06-30, unit usdPerShare.

shares_outstanding.comment: M1 '718 common shares issued and outstanding' (in millions). M2 us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding @ 2026-06-30 = 718000000, unit shares. Check: 19.35 * 718,000,000 = 13,893,300,000 vs net_assets 13,891,000,000, rel diff 0.0166%, inside the 0.5% tolerance of plan check 10.

total_debt_outstanding.comment: M1 balance-sheet liability line 'Debt $15,773' (net of unamortized debt issuance costs and discount). M2 us-gaap:LongTermDebt @ 2026-06-30 = 15773000000. The alternative 15,924,000,000 is us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount @ 2026-06-30, the aggregate principal from the debt note. Plan 3.1 sources this field from 'balance sheet / notes' and allows null, so the test accepts either figure or null and reports which one the parser chose.

prior._comment: Read from the comparative column header, not computed. period_end_prior_kind must be 'prior_fiscal_year_end' because fiscal_year_end is 1231 and 2025-12-31 has MMDD 1231. Gap to 2026-06-30 is 181 days, inside the [80, 380] bound of plan check 7.

total_investments_fv.comment: M1 'Total investments at fair value ... 29,349 29,485' second column. M2 first undimensioned us-gaap:InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue @ 2025-12-31.

total_investments_cost.comment: M1 parenthetical 'and $29,250, respectively'. M2 us-gaap:InvestmentOwnedAtCost @ 2025-12-31. Not tied out in v1: plan section 8 puts the comparative Schedule of Investments out of scope.

total_liabilities.comment: M1 'Total liabilities 16,607 16,917'. M2 us-gaap:Liabilities @ 2025-12-31. M3 CONFIRMS: us-gaap:Liabilities [USD] end=2025-12-31 val=16917000000, accn 0001287750-26-000006.

net_assets.comment: M1 'Total stockholders' equity 13,891 14,318'. M2 us-gaap:StockholdersEquity @ 2025-12-31. M3 CONFIRMS: us-gaap:StockholdersEquity [USD] end=2025-12-31 val=14318000000, accn 0001287750-26-000006.

nav_per_share.comment: M1 'NET ASSET VALUE PER SHARE $19.35 $19.94'. M2 us-gaap:NetAssetValuePerShare @ 2025-12-31.

shares_outstanding.comment: M2 us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding @ 2025-12-31 = 718000000. M1 states '718 common shares issued and outstanding' once, covering both columns. Note the two dates carry the SAME share count after rounding to millions; that is genuine, not a copied column, and total_assets differs (30,498 vs 31,235) so plan check 12 is still satisfied. Check: 19.94 * 718,000,000 = 14,316,920,000 vs 14,318,000,000, rel diff 0.0075%.

total_debt_outstanding.comment: M1 'Debt $15,773 $15,991'. M2 us-gaap:LongTermDebt @ 2025-12-31 = 15991000000; the alternative is us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount @ 2025-12-31 = 16012000000.

derived_identities.columns_rel_diff_total_assets: 2.36%, far inside the 60% bound of plan check 11
derived_identities.columns_rel_diff_net_assets: 2.98%, far inside the 60% bound of plan check 11

sum_investment_fair_value.comment: Plan check 13. The Schedule of Investments position rows must sum to the CURRENT column total, 29,349,000,000. If a parse instead sums to 29,485,000,000 it has tied to the prior column and the column map is inverted. Note the SOI is itself inline-XBRL tagged: us-gaap:InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue occurs 3,823 times in the document, 3,812 of them at instant 2026-06-30, all with scale=6, so filing values are in millions to one decimal.

sum_investment_cost.comment: Plan check 14. The condition (the filing reports a total cost figure) is MET for this filing, via the balance-sheet parenthetical.
